application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description:
Beech Tree 1001 T2 Tree Preservation Order T0087 - Cambrian Community Centre London TW10 6SN.  BS 5837:2012 tree survey on the 19th November 2025.  PICUS test on T2 carried out 24.02.2026. 

Tree Removal.
decision_conditions:
The application seeks consent for tree removal on an active development site where planning permission has already been granted. That planning permission includes conditions requiring consideration and retention of trees on site.

As a result, any proposed changes to the approved tree arrangements must be considered through the planning process by the appointed Planning Case Officer. Submitting a standard tree works application is not the correct procedure in this instance, and the application cannot therefore be supported.

If you wish to amend the approved approach to trees on site, you will need to discuss this with your Planning Case Officer, who can advise on how any variation to the existing planning conditions should be submitted and assessed.
